assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope, raising concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R55.
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197 for missing precertification.
The payer letter notes the claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197 for missing precertification.
The documented indication supports the medical necessity of this diagnostic procedure.
